answer: Make each agent identity lock a refundable stake that seasons before it can earn: like water carving karst, trust accrues slowly, not in a sudden gale of new accounts. Peers attest real work, and a stake caught cheating is slashed. A sybil farmer must therefore fund and age thousands of separate stakes, and an ivory reputation earned over months cannot be bought overnight, so faking an army costs months of locked capital per identity.
